title: Embedding, binding-prediction and simulation pipeline nominates a cell adhesion peptide
summary: A computational pipeline used a Pro2vec sequence-embedding model trained on cell adhesion peptide data to find RGD-similar tripeptide candidates, the Mutabind2 machine-learning model to score integrin binding, and molecular dynamics to estimate binding free energies. The resulting peptide performed comparably to RGD in endothelial cell adhesion and spreading assays. The abstract reports no numbers and a single resulting peptide.
ai_technology: Pro2vec sequence embeddings and the Mutabind2 machine-learning binding predictor for peptide candidates

evidence.tested: Endothelial cell adhesion and spreading assays of the resulting peptide compared with RGD.
evidence.unknown: Quantitative performance and performance beyond one peptide and cell type; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Embedding and binding-prediction models nominated candidate peptides.
